summary.intent: Finish and push two PRs (#242/#634 and #246/#638) in the callisto repo: make names win over row numbers in the interactive `add` CLI flow, shorten hints, add a Breaking changeset paragraph, and update docs/specs, then gate and push each.
summary.outcome: #242 was pushed (614cc2ae1, valid signature) with all findings resolved after the full gate passed on the merge commit. #246's full gate passed on all four steps, and the commit, merge of latest main, and CLI tests were started, but the push and resolve were not confirmed in the transcript.

repo: Each PR has its own session and a gate record; a push is only ready when main is merged, the full gate is green on that exact commit, and the gate record matches.
Docs changes need `doc-check` to pass; error docs (docs/errors.md, e.g. E214 row) and changesets (.changeset/*.md) are updated together with behavior changes.
Breaking behavior changes get a `**Breaking:**` paragraph in the changeset.
The CLI spec (docs/specs/cli.json) and the PTY tests (add_interactive_pty_tests.rs) must be kept in sync with interactive prompt behavior changes.
`pre-push` and the full gate are slow, especially when other sessions are building in parallel.

code.finding: Interactive selection logic was changed so that names take precedence over row numbers; hints were shortened.
PTY test updated to reflect names-win-over-row-numbers behavior.

workflow: Run long gates in the background and push the other ready PR meanwhile to parallelize work.
Merge the latest main before the final gate and push so the gate result applies to the pushed commit.
Verify the gate record and full-history findings before pushing rather than trusting earlier status.

friction: pre-push gate was slow because another session was building in parallel, delaying the #246 commit.
User had to ask 'Ready to push?' and the answer was not yet, since #246 still needed its gate and commit.
open_items: Confirm the #246 (#638) push and resolution of its findings after the merge with latest main and CLI tests.
Verify the CLI tests run after merging main passed.
